description: This file defines a Lua function 'try_cached_html' that attempts to check the existence of a cached HTML file based on a virtual request object, and possibly modifies the request's physical path. It also assigns this function to the 'actions' variable for later use.

methods.name: try_cached_html
methods.description: Checks if a cached HTML file exists for the given virtual request and updates the request's physical path; returns a wait event signal if needed.
